entities.summary: Don Federico de Roncali y Ceruti, 1st Count of Alcoy was a Spanish noble, politician and military who served as Prime Minister of Spain between 1852 and 1853. He held other important offices such as Captain General of Cuba and Minister of State. He was also a senator for life in 1845.
